_comment: Reels Zenie can repost, refreshed automatically every Sunday by .github/scripts/find_reposts.py (workflow: find-reposts.yml). It uses Meta's Instagram Business Discovery API through Zenie's account to list recent reels from the verified cohort in formats/zenie.json, so every url is a real reel and every creator is the account that published it. The drafting agent picks 2 per week in AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md Step 2B. Used reels are recorded in repost_library/used.json and never picked again. Do not edit `reels` by hand; it is overwritten each refresh.
